summary: Resume analyzer application with comprehensive extraction, scoring, polished UI, and a result page for displaying parsed data, scoring breakdown, skill matches, and recommendations with editing, download, and comparison features
architectural_notes: Resume analyzer with extraction and scoring system
Result page accessible after resume upload and analysis
PDF generation capability for report downloads

existing_features.title: Create a new comprehensive result page route that displays all parsed resume data including contact information, work experience with durations and descriptions, education history, skills categorized by type (technical, soft, domain) with proficiency levels, and certifications

Display the comprehensive scoring breakdown on the result page showing the overall resume score, completeness score (name, contact, experience, education, skills), content quality score (experience duration, career progression), formatting score, and skill relevance score with detailed feedback for each dimension

Show skill matches and gaps on the result page by comparing resume skills against the selected job role requirements, highlighting matching skills with green styling and missing or insufficient proficiency skills with red/yellow styling, categorized by technical and soft skills

Display actionable recommendations on the result page including personalized learning resources (courses from Udemy, Coursera, freeCodeCamp) and practice projects for each skill gap identified in the analysis

Implement inline editing functionality on the result page allowing users to modify extracted resume data fields (contact info, work experience, education, skills) with save functionality that updates the backend resume record

Add a download report button on the result page that generates and downloads a comprehensive PDF report containing the resume analysis including job role match percentage, matching and missing skills, personalized recommendations, and candidate profile data (experience, education, certifications)

Implement a compare feature on the result page that allows users to select and analyze multiple resumes side-by-side, displaying comparative metrics such as overall scores, skill overlap, experience levels, and education backgrounds for all selected candidates
Configure automatic navigation to the result page after a user successfully uploads and analyzes a resume, passing the resume ID and analysis data through URL parameters or application state

Design the result page UI to match the existing application style with warm education-focused color palette (coral primary, teal secondary, amber accent), ensuring responsive layout, proper spacing, and visual hierarchy that highlights key information like scores and recommendations

new_feature_requests.summary: Result page with parsed resume data display, scoring breakdown, skill matches, recommendations, inline editing, PDF download, and multi-resume comparison
